units.raw: `As you leave your ship, you see a crowd watching a video screen not far from your landing spot. The video jumps between a panel discussion and footage of Admiral Danforth being quizzed by Parliament. It has finished by the time you arrive, and many of the onlookers have already left for their business. Two captains remain, however, and, by the sounds of it, they're having a passionate discussion about the video.`
